claims.text: Clinic notes and structured EHR medication histories often contain different medication information.

claims.text: Discrepancies between clinic notes and structured EHR medication histories may arise from normalization errors, terminology differences, or documentation timing.

claims.text: This study develops a note-grounded evaluation framework using LLM-assisted reference construction, human review, deterministic normalization, and semantic-temporal comparison with structured records.

claims.text: The goal of the study is to characterize the nature of mismatches rather than treat them as simple errors.
claims.poster_quote: The goal is to characterize the nature of mismatches rather than treat them as simple errors, enabling more accurate downstream clinical inference.
